newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cultus says has buyer for Yolla stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cultus says has buyer for Yolla stake.

text.p: Cultus Petroleum NL said on Friday it had accepted an offer for its 27 percent stake in the undeveloped Yolla gas field in Bass Strait, but would not reveal the buyer.
"We have accepted an offer but we have not finalised the agreement," company secretary Sam Russotti told Reuters.
"I cannot say who with," he said.
Russotti said he also could not reveal any price details until the agreement was signed and sealed.
Development of the field, 57 percent owned by Boral Ltd, would depend on reserves and available markets, he said.
Cultus had decided to sell its stake as it did not regard it as part of the company's corporate growth area, Russotti said.
Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd declined to respond to a report it was the buyer, saying it did not comment on acquisition and divestment matters.
